name: Service QFailure (SA)
help: Query the failure recovery actions for a Windows service
long_help: Retrieves failure recovery configuration including reset period, reboot message, command line, and failure actions (restart, reboot, run command). Equivalent to 'sc qfailure'.

arguments.name: hostname
arguments.desc: Target hostname or IP address (default: local machine)

arguments.name: servicename
arguments.desc: Service name to query (not display name)
